reply: at all reaches about 0.2% residual, and the saturating-exponential and log forms both fit the eps-dependence closely. So the law is mainly a function of strain, with a small temperature correction that I could not pin down. I used all 14 tool calls, and the last one (a power-law variant) was worse.

best.code:
def equation(eps, T, params):
    return (params[0]+params[1]*T)*np.log(1+(params[2]+params[3]*T)*eps) + (params[4]+params[5]*T)*eps + params[6]*eps**2
